name: Birthday Wish Mail
description: Sends a templated birthday-greeting email to users automatically on their birthday, driven by cron and a configurable date-of-birth field.
project_description:
Send birthday wish mail and notification to the user. When the user's birthday comes.

 A "date of birth" field will have to add to your user manage fields. That field machine name will be added by a Developer in Birthday wish mail config. For more information please see screenshots.

 Using hook_cron() to send birthday mail 

 Install it like any other module 

 composer require drupal/birthday_wish_mail
